LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RestartNote: Changes in this section take effect after a restart. Turning vehicles off is safe for a running colony: their added parts are dropped when the save loads.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_ScopeAllVehicles: Every vehicle with a fitting design
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_ScopeAllVehiclesDes: Every vehicle from any mod gets batteries, coolant, oil, tyres, brakes and the rest, by what it runs on and whether it drives, floats or flies.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_ScopePhobosOnlyDesc: Other mods' vehicles stay exactly as their authors made them.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingShowOnlyDesc: The systems run and show their state, but nothing happens to the vehicles: no wear, failures, refusals or slowing. Messages still tell you what would have happened.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingFuelGellingD: Below about -8 °C chemfuel behaves like diesel and gels: a cold vehicle will not start until it is warmer, in a heated room or on a warmer day. Off by default, because nothing says chemfuel is diesel.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SectionRemove: Removing vehicle systems from a colony
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_DrivetrainOffDesc: No gears, engine speed or traction. Engine load stays the simple moving-or-idling figure the other systems used before.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_DrivetrainDisplayOn: Vehicles show their gear, engine speed and load, and heat and charge follow them, but no vehicle is ever slowed by its engine, its weight or the ground.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_DrivetrainFullDesc: As above, and a vehicle slows where its engine runs out of power (heavy loads, steep or soft ground) or its wheels run out of grip. A vehicle that cannot grip crawls on at a fraction of its speed rather than stopping.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingLoadFuelDesc: Off by default: vehicles burn fuel at the rate their authors set. On: a laden vehicle climbing through sand burns more, an empty one on a road less, and an idling engine burns a little while parked. At an ordinary cruise the rate matches the author's.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingNightHeaterD: Off by default: a caravan's vehicles shut their engines down at the night camp, and their cabs cool to the night air. On: a vehicle whose night heater switch is on burns a little fuel through the night to keep its cab warm, as trucks' parking heaters do. Switch each vehicle's night heater on before the caravan leaves.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingHoverLimit: When an aircraft is too heavy or too hot to lift off or hover onto its pad
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_HoverRefusePadUseRu: Refuse it: use the runway, or lighten it (default)

A jump jet whose engine cannot hold it in a hover, because it is heavily laden or the day is hot, lands on a runway like an ordinary jet. An order to land on the pad is refused with the reason. A helicopter or a thrust-lifted pod whose engines cannot lift it, because it is laden, the day is hot or engines are out, will not launch until it is lightened, repaired or the air cools.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_HoverAllowWithDamag: Allow it, at a cost to the engine
The landing or lift-off goes ahead with the engines run past their limits: they wear and you are told.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_HoverWarnOnly: Allow it, with a warning only
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_HoverWarnOnlyDesc: The landing or lift-off goes ahead as the aircraft's own mod allows, and a message says it was beyond the engines.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingRealisticFee: Off by default: a water stop draws a tenth of a locomotive's real tender or tank capacity, so a 4-8-4's refill fits in one Dubs Bad Hygiene water tower. On: it draws the real figure, 68,000 litres for the big 4-8-4, which needs several towers or a huge one.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingBoilerExplos: Off by default. On: a boiler without a fusible plug (the American 4-8-4) whose water falls below the firebox crown with the fire lit explodes, wrecking the boiler and hurting everything nearby. Boilers with a plug still only vent.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_BoilerExplosionsWar: Warning: an exploding boiler can kill the crew and anyone nearby and wreck what stands around it, without a second chance. Watch the water glass, and give it water stops in time.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingJumpStartNee: On by default: a jump-start needs a jump-start kit, in stock on the map (the helper fetches it) or aboard the caravan. Craft one at a machining table or a fabrication bench; it is never used up. Off: the leads are free, as before.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingAssumeBooste: Every vehicle carries a booster pack

Off by default: a jump-start needs another vehicle near enough (or in the same caravan) with charge to give, so a lone vehicle with a flat battery waits for one. On: every vehicle is taken to carry a charged booster pack, and a jump-start needs no other vehicle, on the map or in a caravan.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RemoveExplain: Vehicles save their parts in order, so a save made with these systems cannot simply lose them. Before you remove D'thorga Framework or Vehicle Framework from a colony, load it, press this button, save, then remove the mod. Turning vehicles or systems off above needs none of this.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RemoveButton: Remove the added parts from this colony's vehicles
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RemoveConfirm: Remove every part the vehicle systems added, from every vehicle in this colony, and stop the systems until you restart? Save straight afterwards, then remove the mod.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RemoveDone: Done. Save now, then remove the mod. The systems stay stopped until you restart.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RemoveResult: The added parts were removed from {COUNT} vehicles. Save now, then remove the mod.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RequestServiceDesc: Have a mechanic service this vehicle as soon as they can, even if nothing is due yet. Haulers first load the supplies each service needs into its cargo; then a constructor does the work. The vehicle must be parked and not in use.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_LoadDraw: Draws {AMPS} A from the battery or the alternator while it runs.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_InspectEngineer: Engine load {LOAD}, electrical draw {AMPS} A, air {AIR}.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_InspectPower: Load {LOAD}: engine {ENGINE} kW, fuel {FUEL} kW, heat {HEAT} kW.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_WaterNoPlumbing: park it beside a plumbing pipe with a water tower on it.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_WaterTowersEmpty: the water towers on the pipe beside it are nearly empty.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RefuseFlatBattery: The {VEHICLE}'s battery is too weak to start the engine. Have a colonist jump-start it from another vehicle parked near it, park it beside a powered conduit or battery to charge, or warm it: a cold battery gives less.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RefuseStarter: The {VEHICLE}'s starter motor is broken. Repair the vehicle to start it.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RefuseFuelGelled: The {VEHICLE}'s fuel has thickened in the cold. Warm the vehicle in a heated room, or wait for a warmer day.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RefuseBrakesWorn: The {VEHICLE}'s brakes are worn through. A mechanic must fit new pads before it drives.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RefuseBrakesWrecked: The {VEHICLE}'s brakes are wrecked. Repair the vehicle before it drives.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RefuseAirBrakes: The {VEHICLE}'s air brakes are still held on. Leave the engine running a few minutes to build air pressure.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RefuseLiftOff: The {VEHICLE}'s engines cannot lift it as it is: too heavy for this heat, or with engines out. Unload some cargo or passengers, repair its engines, or wait for cooler air.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RefuseRaisingSteam: The {VEHICLE} has too little steam to move. Keep it drafted with its fire lit until the boiler is up to pressure: from cold that takes hours.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RefusePlugMelted: The {VEHICLE}'s fusible plug has melted and its boiler is vented. A mechanic must fit a new plug before it can raise steam again.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_RefuseHungStart: The {VEHICLE}'s battery cannot spin its turbine fast enough to light. Have a colonist jump-start it from another vehicle parked near it, or charge the battery beside a powered conduit.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgBatteryFreezing: The {VEHICLE}'s flat battery is freezing and may crack. Charge it or move it somewhere warmer.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgOverheating: The {VEHICLE}'s engine is overheating and taking damage. Stop it and let it cool.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgCoolantLow: The {VEHICLE} is low on coolant. A service will top it up.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgOilLow: The {VEHICLE} is low on oil. A service will top it up.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgOilPressureLow: The {VEHICLE}'s oil pressure is low; the engine wears while it runs.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgServiceDue: The {VEHICLE} is due for a service.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgServiceOverdue: The {VEHICLE} is overdue for a service; its parts are failing more often.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgTyresWorn: The {VEHICLE}'s tyres or tracks are worn.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgTyreFailed: The {VEHICLE}'s worn-out {PART} has failed on the move.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgBrakesWorn: The {VEHICLE}'s brakes are worn; its driver is taking it gently.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgTransmissionHot: The {VEHICLE}'s gearbox is overheating and wearing as it drives.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgHydraulicsLow: The {VEHICLE} is low on hydraulic fluid.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgTurbineHot: The {VEHICLE}'s turbine is running past its continuous limit; its hot section is wearing fast.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgTurbineOverTop: The {VEHICLE}'s turbine is past every limit and taking damage. Ease off or land.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgHotSectionWorn: The {VEHICLE}'s turbine hot section is worn out and may fail. A mechanic should overhaul it.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgHotStart: The {VEHICLE}'s weak battery lit its turbine hot, wearing the hot section. A jump-start gives a clean start.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgInjectionWaterOu: The {VEHICLE} has used its injection water; its engine is back to its dry limits until a mechanic refills the tank.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgLiftStrained: The {VEHICLE} lifted off beyond its engines' limits, and they took the strain.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgLiftBeyond: The {VEHICLE} lifted off beyond what its engines can carry at this weight in this heat.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgOverTorque: The {VEHICLE}'s rotor drive is being asked for more than it can take, and is wearing. Lighten it or ease off.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgTractionMotorsHo: The {VEHICLE}'s traction motors are running hot from hard pulling.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgTractionMotorsOv: The {VEHICLE}'s traction motors are overheating and burning their windings. Ease the load and let them cool.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgBoilerWaterLow: The {VEHICLE}'s boiler water is low. Keep its feed water topped up, or the fire will burn the crown sheet dry.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgFeedWaterLow: The {VEHICLE} is nearly out of feed water. It needs a water stop soon.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgHoverRefused: The {VEHICLE} is too heavy for its engine to hover onto the pad in this heat. Land it on a runway, or lighten it.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgHoverStrained: The {VEHICLE} is hovering beyond its engine's limits; its hot section is taking the strain.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgHoverBeyond: The {VEHICLE} is hovering beyond what its engine can hold at this weight in this heat.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_CannotJumpStartNoDo: Cannot jump-start the {VEHICLE}: no vehicle with a charged battery or a running engine is within {REACH} cells. Park one beside it.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_CannotJumpStartNoPa: Cannot jump-start the {VEHICLE}: there is nowhere to stand beside it that can be reached.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_JumpStarted: {HELPER} has jump-started the {VEHICLE} from the {DONOR}. It will start now; drive it to charge the battery.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_JumpStartFailed: {HELPER} could not jump-start the {VEHICLE}: the {DONOR} has too little charge left or has moved away.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_JumpStartOptionBoos: Jump-start the {VEHICLE} from its booster pack
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_JumpStartedBooster: {HELPER} has jump-started the {VEHICLE} from its booster pack. It will start now; drive it to charge the battery.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_CannotJumpStartNoKi: Cannot jump-start the {VEHICLE}: there is no jump-start kit to fetch. Craft one at a machining table or a fabrication bench.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_CaravanJumpStartDes: A crew member connects the leads and cranks the {VEHICLE}. The charge comes from the other vehicle, or from the booster pack every vehicle carries.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_CannotJumpStartNoKi: No jump-start kit in the caravan to connect the {VEHICLE} with.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_CannotJumpStartNoDo: No other vehicle in the caravan has the charge to give the {VEHICLE}.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_CannotJumpStartNoHe: Nobody in the caravan is able to jump-start the {VEHICLE}.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_CaravanCapExplanati: {VEHICLE} held to {CAP} of its speed by its engine or the ground
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneBatteryAmpHours: How much charge the starting battery holds. A typical car battery is about 45; a heavy vehicle's pair about 100.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneAlternatorAmpsD: What the alternator gives while the engine runs, before the lights and heater take their share.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneStarterAmpHours: What each start takes from the battery in mild weather; more in the cold.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneEngineHeat: Engine heat at full load (°C an hour)
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneEngineHeatDesc: How fast the engine heats its coolant while driving. Higher runs hotter.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneRadiatorRateDes: How strongly the radiator pulls the coolant toward the air once the thermostat opens. Higher runs cooler.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneThermostatDesc: The coolant temperature at which the radiator starts working. Real thermostats open at about 82 to 90.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneOilBurn: Oil burned (share an hour at full load)
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneOilBurnDesc: How fast the engine uses its oil. Lower means fewer top-ups between services.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneTreadWear: Tyre and track wear (share an hour moving)
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneTreadWearDesc: How fast tyres or track pads wear on the move. At 0.0025 they are worn after about 240 hours of driving.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneGearboxHeat: Gearbox heat at full load (°C an hour)
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneGearboxHeatDesc: How fast hard driving heats the gearbox's oil.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneCompressorDesc: How fast the engine builds air for the air brakes. Only trucks with air brakes use it.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TuneAirLeakDesc: How fast a parked truck loses its brake air. Only trucks with air brakes use it.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_LetterBoilingText: The {VEHICLE}'s coolant is boiling away and the engine is cooking itself.\n\nStop the vehicle now. Once it has cooled, repair the radiator and have a mechanic service it to refill the coolant.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_LetterPlugMeltedTex: The water in the {VEHICLE}'s boiler fell below the firebox crown. The lead plug in the crown melted and blew steam onto the fire, venting the boiler before the crown sheet could fail.\n\nIt cannot raise steam again until a mechanic fits a new plug. Give it feed water at a water stop before you light it again.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_LetterBoilerExplode: The water in the {VEHICLE}'s boiler fell below the firebox crown while the fire burned. With no fusible plug to vent it, the dry crown sheet softened and tore, and the boiler's water flashed to steam all at once.\n\nThe boiler is wrecked. Tend the wounded; repair the boiler before it can steam again, and keep its water up next time.
